# TabTasks

Features described: 0.6.0. Chrome 116+. Browser-language default, English fallback, manual English/Simplified Chinese. Three Free text sizes. Store review and distribution can lag; check the installed version.

Free: 30 active tasks · 3 custom lists; Notes, tags, excerpts, subtasks and dates; JSON backup and calendar export; 1 reusable flow template · 1 smart view; Single-task AI with your API key; Three text sizes, themes and last-change undo.

Pro: No active-task or custom-list count limits; Multiple templates and project-name variables; Cross-list flows and batch starts; More smart views, grouping and pins; Multi-task AI planning and saved instructions.

Completed tasks and built-in lists do not use the 30 / 3 allowance. Pro removes these product count limits; local storage and browser resources still apply.

Choose an OpenAI Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages compatible service, API address and model. Compatibility depends on the provider implementation. Use your own API key; API usage is billed by that provider and is not included in Pro. A consumer chat subscription does not necessarily include API access.

Applicable tax is shown at checkout. Each product is purchased separately. Existing Pro licenses include this update. Start in the extension for automatic activation after payment verification. Email recovery and existing license codes remain available.

Content stays local; no extension usage analytics or cloud sync. The website has separate traffic analytics described in its privacy policy.
